Welcome to FelineMetrics. Forget the generic tips and cute videos: our focus is biology, data, and applied veterinary science. 🔬

I am Dr. Ray, a feline researcher. My mission is to translate your cat's physiology into visual and mathematical analysis. 📊

Cats are predators wired to hide their pain. When symptoms finally appear, the internal damage is already done. Our goal is to expose these invisible threats and act surgically before the diagnosis. ⚠️

What you will discover here:
🥩 Hidden Nutrition: The biochemical impact of commercial food, hydration, and insulin.
🛡️ Longevity: Clinical protocols to protect their kidneys and liver against toxins in your home.
🧠 Neuroscience: The math behind cortisol (stress) and feline behavior.

📅 NEW research and analysis EVERY DAY.

👇 SUBSCRIBE NOW to make data-driven decisions and guarantee extra years of health for your feline!
